Chapter 6641: So Magical

Chapter 6641: So Magical

Powerful emperors were closer to mortals than they were to overlords. Now, an overlord willingly shared his fortune with everyone. The blessing of an overlord couldn’t possibly be a bad thing.

Instead of chasing after it in vain, it became readily available for all.

“The disaster of an overlord can end the world.” True Emperor Jiu Ning said solemnly.

“Yes, an absolute end.” Another primordial overlord said.

A tribulation ending him would spell the end of Three Immortals. Perhaps the mortals connected to him would only get a single bolt. However, that would be more than enough to kill them.

This was the reason why the apex cultivators wanted no part in this. Although they lacked the fortune of the same realm, they still had freedom and happiness.

“Break!” Dugu Yuan and the others made up their mind.

Not long ago, they risked their lives for the spring of fortune. Now, they wanted no part of the very source and tried to expel the water.

Meanwhile, the Three Immortals within World Seal became firmly locked as time passed. Grand Preceptor and the others staggered backward during the process.

“It’s forceful, not giving anyone else a choice.” Visceraless warned.

“We have to break out, this will only get worse with time.” Jiu Ning said.

They roared and activated all of their power. They worked together to break the seal and expel the water. Wondrous flames erupted around them.

Other primal ancestors and heaven-slayers followed their lead. Their powers swept through heaven and earth.

These powers came together to form the most brilliant beam of light, shooting straight at World Seal.

For some, being shackled to an overlord was a good thing but they were already living well.

“Boom!” Alas, the beam couldn’t move the duplicated Three Immortals or World Seal.

On the other hand, a supreme force pressed them back.

“What now?” Grand Preceptor’s group turned pale, attempting to break away from what they had fought each other for.

“Can’t resist.” Light God said.

“Rumble!” The bright harmonization moved onto the next stage.

Inhabitants of the world felt as if an overlord had possessed them. When they looked around, they saw everything in full view. Mysteries became obvious.

“It’s magical.” They became excited, thinking they were ascending.

“More.” They willingly offered everything to become one with the supreme overlord.

“Boom!” The harmonization reached its limit. The new world descended and attempted to stack with the original.

“No!” Those in space shouted because the inhabitants’ willingness only strengthened the process and improved the flow.
